title: PEARL: Path-Entity Aligned Relational Learning with Contextual Subgraphs for Inductive Knowledge Graph Completion
abstract: arXiv:2609.02216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inductive knowledge graph completion (IKGC) aims to predict missing links involving entities unseen during training, requiring models to learn transferable relational and structural patterns. Existing subgraph- and path-based approaches often encode relational paths independently of their surrounding query subgraphs, although the predictive relevance of a path may vary across structural contexts. We propose PEARL, a Path-Entity Aligned Relational Learning framework that models paths as context-conditioned reasoning signals. PEARL constructs a query-specific contextual subgraph from the union of the query entities' neighborhoods and uses a large language model (LLM)-guided retriever to distill semantically relevant paths. It then builds a bipartite interaction graph over paths, contextual entities, and a global subgraph representation, allowing path embeddings to adapt to local and global structural evidence. translated_title: PEARL：面向归纳式知识图谱补全的基于上下文子图的路径-实体对齐关系学习
translated_abstract: 归纳式知识图谱补全（IKGC）旨在预测涉及训练期间未见实体的缺失链接，这要求模型学习可迁移的关系模式与结构模式。现有的基于子图和基于路径的方法通常独立于其周围的查询子图来编码关系路径，然而一条路径的预测相关性可能随结构上下文而变化。我们提出了PEARL，一个路径-实体对齐关系学习框架，它将路径建模为上下文条件化的推理信号。PEARL从查询实体邻域的并集构建查询特定的上下文子图，并利用大语言模型（LLM）引导的检索器来提炼语义相关的路径。随后，它在路径、上下文实体与全局子图表示之上构建二部交互图，使路径嵌入能够适应当地与全局的结构证据。为了抑制引入的噪声……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PEARL提出将关系路径建模为上下文条件化的推理信号，通过构建查询特定上下文子图、LLM引导的路径检索以及路径-实体-全局子图的二部交互图，使路径嵌入感知局部与全局结构证据，从而提升归纳式知识图谱补全的效果。
en_tdlr: PEARL models relational paths as context-conditioned reasoning signals, combining query-specific contextual subgraphs, LLM-guided path retrieval, and a bipartite interaction graph over paths, entities, and global subgraph representations to improve inductive knowledge graph completion.
